meta.parties: Eliashamy v. Punchi Banda Et Al

rules.statement: A plaintiff who has parted with dominium cannot obtain a declaration of title in an action rei vindicatio.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think that either section 18 or section 404 is helpful to the plaintiff in the position in which he has placed himself by conveying the property in question to third parties, for no declaration of title can be made in this action in favour of the purchasers so long as the plaintiff is on the record."
